format: html

```{r}
#|label: setup
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Width, y = Sepal.Length, color = Species)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, 4.5), breaks = seq(1, 4.5, by = 0.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1, 8), breaks = 1:8) +
  labs(
    title = "Iris Sepal Measurements",
    x = "Sepal width",
    y = "Sepal length",
    color = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
